Class EconomyService

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.service.EconomyService
public class EconomyService extends Object
Service for interacting with the server's economy system via Vault.

This service wraps Vault's Economy provider and exposes fail-safe methods for depositing, withdrawing, and checking player balances. All operations gracefully handle the case where Vault is not installed.

When Vault is absent, all monetary operations return false and log a warning. This ensures the action/requirement engine never crashes due to a missing optional dependency.

Example:

EconomyService eco = new EconomyService(dependencyService);
if (eco.withdraw(player, 100.0)) {
    // payment successful
}
